name: Patrick SFB
description: Patrick SFB supports Eastern Range space launch operations and hosts Space Launch Delta 45. It is the primary launch support base for Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

Kickstart your morning with a refreshing sunrise yoga session right on the waters of the Banana River. Led by our expert fitness center instructor, you will flow through poses on a paddleboard as the sun comes up. If water conditions aren't ideal for floating yoga, we’ll move the practice to the scenic ODR docks, followed immediately by an invigorating morning paddle on the river.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Space Coast Inn (321-494-6590) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (321-494-3647) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 45 FSS, M&FRC, and official Patrick sites for in-processing and space launch support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
